title: Problem Tree Schema
description: Hierarchical structure for problem decomposition where top-level problems are recursively decomposed into subproblems, such that the conjunction of subproblems entails the parent problem

problem-tree.description: Root container for all problems in the tree

problem.description: A problem node in the hierarchical tree. Can contain nested subproblems recursively.

problem-id.description: Unique identifier for this problem node

problem-name.description: Name or title of the problem

problem-description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be solved

problem-analysis.description: Analysis explaining why this problem exists and how it relates to the parent problem

sub-problems.description: Array of subproblems that jointly entail this problem. Can contain nested problem objects recursively.

requirements-references.description: Array of requirement IDs (from set R) that this problem addresses

domain-knowledge-references.description: Array of domain knowledge IDs (from set K) relevant to this problem

validation-status.description: Track validation state for completeness conditions

domain-knowledge-validated.description: Whether domain knowledge (K) has been validated

conjunction-logic-verified.description: Whether subproblems jointly entail parent problem

atomic-problem.description: Whether this problem is atomic (no further decomposition needed)
